text:
Predicates:
Romance(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Within(x, y) ::: x is within y.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French ::: a specific language.
Spanish ::: a specific language.
German ::: a specific language.
Basque ::: a specific language.
RelatedTo(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
NotRelated(x, y) ::: x is not related to y.

Premises:
∀x (Romance(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
Romance(RomanceLanguages) ::: The Romance languages form a language family.
∀x (LanguageFamily(x) → ∀y (Within(y, x) → Related(y, y))) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Within(French, RomanceLanguages) ::: French is within the Romance language family.
Within(Spanish, RomanceLanguages) ::: Spanish is within the Romance language family.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
¬Related(Basque, x) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
